Application Data.NAME: ABC Employment Solutions, LLC
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: ABC Employment Solutions, LLC is a full-service employment agency specializing in the placement of temporary and permanent staff in various sectors, including administrative, clerical, and light industrial roles. We prioritize compliance with labor laws and maintain rigorous standards for candidate screening and vetting. Our agency does not engage in the placement of personnel in high-risk roles without specialized underwriting approval and implements strict controls to ensure that all subcontractors are licensed and compliant with industry regulations. Additionally, we offer optional coverages such as Professional Liability and Employment Practices Liability Insurance to safeguard against potential claims arising from our operations.
